scheme_name: PM Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
other_conditions: Must possess a Certificate of Vending or Identity Card issued by the Urban Local Body (ULB).
Vendors identified in the ULB survey but not yet issued the certificate are eligible.
Vendors omitted from the survey or who started vending after the survey are eligible if they have a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from the ULB or Town Vending Committee.
Vendors from surrounding peri‑urban or rural areas within the ULB’s geographical limits are eligible if they have an LoR from the ULB/TVC.
benefits_summary: Provides collateral‑free micro‑loans up to ₹10,000 (with higher subsequent loans) at a 7% interest subsidy, plus a cashback of up to ₹100 per month for street vendors.
